description: Every finite tuple from the witness hull has all of its coordinates in a single finite stage, including the empty tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.witnessHull_tuple_stage.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (m : M) (X : Set M) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → M)
  (ha : ∀ (i : Fin n), a i ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.witnessHull m X) :
  ∃ r, ∀ (i : Fin n), a i ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementarySubmodels.witnessStage m X r
